en.headline: Engineer injured after falling onto rebar at Sheung Shui housing site
en.dek: A 32-year-old structural engineer was taken to hospital after a vertical rebar pierced his lower jaw while he was inspecting work at a Housing Department site on Friday morning.
body: Police and the Labour Department are investigating an industrial accident at a public housing construction site in Sheung Shui on Friday morning in which a structural engineer was impaled by a steel bar.

According to reports, the 32-year-old man, surnamed Wong, was checking rebar with colleagues on a wooden platform at the site on Ching Hiu Road when he lost his balance and fell forward. A vertical rebar pierced his lower jaw from below. Emergency crews shortened the bar and transported him, still conscious, with the remaining section in place to Prince of Wales Hospital in Sha Tin for treatment.

The Housing Department said it was concerned about the incident at the site, which is carrying out superstructure works, and had required the contractor, Gammon Construction, to inspect safety measures immediately and strengthen training. The case has been classified as an industrial accident.

zh.headline: 工程師上水房署地盤檢查鋼筋時失平衡 下顎被鐵枝插穿送院
zh.dek: 周五早上上水清曉路一房屋署公營房屋地盤發生工業意外，一名32歲結構工程師下顎被垂直鋼筋插穿，送往醫院治理。
body: 警方及勞工處正調查周五早上上水一公營房屋建築地盤的工業意外，一名結構工程師被鋼筋插傷。
據報導，32歲姓黃的工程師當時與同事在清曉路地盤的木板平台上檢查鋼筋，懷疑踩空失去平衡向前跌倒，一支垂直鋼筋從下方穿透其下顎。救援人員將鐵枝剪短後，連人帶餘下鐵枝將他送往沙田威爾斯親王醫院，他送院時仍清醒。
房屋署表示關注事件，該地盤正進行上蓋工程，已要求承建商金門建築立即檢查安全設施並加強培訓。案件列作工業意外，勞工處及警方跟進調查。
